Name: (CP) Bird Nest Retexture for the Bird overhaul - Ornithologist's Guild Mod
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

Retexture's the bird nest sprites to match a variety of recolour mods. Here's the full list of colours:

[list]
[*]Black
[*]Desaturated Vanilla Version
[*]Brown
[*]Grey
[*]Dark Blue
[*]Light Blue
[*]Pink
[*]White
[/list]
Includes the Nests in trees, Perches and Hatching sprites!

The content patcher mod let's you swap between the recoloured nests that you see in the trees using the Generic Mod Config mod. However to edit the map tilesheets nest display you need to manually replace the images. Below are the steps to do so & the mod comes with a Read Me file.

Let me know if there's any bugs or if you'd like me to add any new colours!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

There are two parts to this mod, the Content Patcher Module and the replacing .png module. Here's a step by step process:

PART 1 - CONTENT PATCHER MOD
 
[list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod
[*]Move the '[CP] Bird Nest Retexture for the Ornithologist Mod' into your mods folder


PART 2 - REPLACING .pngs

[/list]For 'Manual Replacement Section' you will need to replace the .pngs from the original mods folder
Heres a step by step instruction of how to replace the .pngs:

FOR THE BABY HATCHLING RETEXTURE
[list=1]
[*]Open the 'Hatching Sprites' folder & choose the edited colour nest version you wish to use
[*]Rename your chosen recoloured nest 'nest' (e.g. Rename 'Pink Hatching' to 'nest')
[*]Open the Ornithologist Guild Mod and follow this folder path \Ornithologists Guild Mod\Ornithologists Guild\assets
[*]Replace the nest.png with the recoloured nest and you're all done!
[/list]
FOR PERCH AND NEST RETEXTURE
[list=1]
[*]Open the 'Perches & Nest Colour' folder & choose the edited colour nest and perch version you wish to use
[*]Rename your chosen recoloured nest 'Perch' (e.g. Rename 'Pink Nest Metal Perch' to 'Perch')
[*]Open the [CP] Ornithologist Guild and follow this folder path \Ornithologists Guild Mod\[CP] Ornithologists Guild\assets\map
[*]Replace the Perch.png with the recoloured nest and perch and you're all done!
[/list][list=1]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]

A big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/81086143]ivylovesbirds[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/145160698] [/url]for giving me permission to release this mod. Checkout the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14510]Main Mod[/url]﻿!
[/list]
[size=4]The bird nest sprites were adapted from the wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24183]Bird Nest Tiles by dollynhoevida[/url] - with the unused Brown nest sprite added here![/size]

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley :)[/center]
